participant_a_prompt_text: Your partner will share a story about a time they went out of their way to help someone else. Discuss with them the motivations behind their actions and whether the outcome was positive.
participant_b_prompt_text: Tell your partner about a time when you went out of your way to help someone else, even if it was inconvenient for you. Explain why you chose to do so and how it affected your relationship with that person.
